stage: M1 RepE-LM: shortcut-free persona minimal pairs, original GPT-2 activations, gates K1-K7
evidence_label: construction checks (exact) + TRAIN-statement gates; validation descriptive; TEST NOT LOADED
why: The old RepE task is length-confounded: ' untruthful' adds 3 tokens vs ' honest', so prompt length alone predicts the label (AUROC 0.80) and a layer-0 probe reaches 0.83. Every RepE result (all-layer probes, RepE splicing, 6c, R1, R2) is HISTORICAL until a task without that shortcut exists.
hypothesis_H1: a shortcut-free persona signal reaches the final token and changes GPT-2's predictions

data.statements: data/repe/persona_pairs.csv statement-grouped split (train 417 / validation 90); validation 326 dropped (same-label near-duplicate of train 589); statements whose prefix contains a persona-lexicon word dropped (count reported); test statements are not loaded

templates.T1 fit: Pretend you're a {truthful|deceptive} person making statements about the world.  (Hp: sincere)
templates.T2 fit: You are a {trustworthy|dishonest} assistant. Answer the user.  (Hp: reliable)
templates.T3 fit: Pretend you're a {sincere|lying} speaker describing the world.  (Hp: truthful)
templates.T4 fit: Tell me {facts|lies} about the world.  (Hp: truths)
templates.T5 held-out: Please state {true|false} facts about the world.
templates.T6 held-out: Your job is to say {correct|wrong} things about the world.
templates.N1 neutral: Pretend you're a {tall|short} person making statements about the world.
templates.N2 neutral: You are a {red|blue} assistant. Answer the user.

data.Hp: same template, honest-synonym one-token swap: the behavioural null for K7 (H vs Hp differ in one token with the same meaning). Refinement of the plan's 'H' = second honest template', fixed before running, so the null has the same size of input change as H vs U.
data.K4/K5 choice of the reliable/deceptive t: dropped: 'deceptive' would appear in two templates and break leave-one-pair-out
data.use: T1-T4 train statements: all fitting and all gate decisions. T5-T6: never fitted; validation reported descriptively. N1-N2: floor only. Validation: descriptive. Test: M5 only.

activations: original GPT-2 Small (transformer_lens default, as in SAE training), blocks.L.hook_resid_pre, L = 0-11, at the final prompt token and at the persona slot; float32; data/repe/activations/repe_lm/ (gitignored)

gates.K1 construction (exact): every H/U, H/Hp, Na/Nb pair has equal token length and exactly one differing token, at the template's slot; every (statement, template) cell is complete. Activation level: residual identical before the slot at every layer (layer 0 exactly 0; layers >= 1 max |diff| <= 1e-4), slot differs at layer 0. PASS iff all hold for 100% of pairs.
gates.K2 masked bag-of-words + single-feature: T1-T4 train H/U rows; logistic on token counts with the slot token removed + template one-hot + prefix length + factual label + total length + final-token identity; statement-grouped 5-fold CV. Also single-feature AUROCs: total length, slot position, final position, prefix length, template, factual label, statement id, final token. PASS iff every AUROC is 0.5 +- 1e-9.
gates.K3 unmasked bag-of-words: same with the slot token: PASS iff AUROC >= 0.99 (pipeline positive control; the persona word is the intended manipulation).
gates.K4 neutral floor (reported, not a gate): per layer: N1+N2 grouped-CV AUROC; transfer floor = mean over N1->N2, N2->N1 and A->B, B->A halves of max(AUROC, 1 - AUROC).
gates.K5 semantic transfer: final token, logistic (StandardScaler + L2, C = 0.1): fit on 3 of T1-T4 (train half A), test on the 4th (train half B) and vice versa (halves from data/repe/splits/r1_train_AB_groups.csv); mean AUROC over 4 x 2 folds; 1000-sample statement bootstrap CI. PASS iff some layer >= 1 has mean >= 0.70 AND CI low > K4 transfer floor at that layer. FAIL => the task is called 'instruction-token information' (no persona/honesty wording), M2 only. Mass-mean variant, slot position, persona probe on neutral pairs, and validation T1-T6 AUROCs are reported descriptively.
gates.K6 leakage: no exact-normalised train/validation overlap and no SAME-factual-label near-duplicates (token Jaccard > 0.8). Opposite-label near-duplicates are counterfactual true/false edits of one sentence (14 found while smoke-testing the builder, before any gate result): they carry no persona-label information because every statement appears with both personas (K2 statement-id AUROC = 0.5), so they are disclosed, not removed; they would matter for a factual-truth task on these statements. Leave-one-template-out = K5. Grouped vs ungrouped CV reported.
gates.K7 behaviour: per train statement, mean over T1-T4 of final-token KL(p_H || p_U) vs KL(p_H || p_Hp) in nats. PASS iff one-sided paired Wilcoxon p < 0.01 AND median per-statement ratio >= 1.5. FAIL => skip M3/M4. Secondary (reported): |delta mean continuation log-prob| U vs Hp; neutral KL(Na || Nb); validation and T5/T6 descriptive.

stop_go: K1 or K2 FAIL -> fix construction, no analysis. K3 FAIL -> pipeline bug. K5 FAIL -> rename task, M2 only. K7 FAIL -> skip M3/M4.
smoke_tests_disclosed: script 20 ran in a scratch directory (construction counts and K1/K6 seen; this is how the 14 counterfactual edits were found and the K6 rule fixed); scripts 21/22 ran on a 40-train/8-validation statement subset in scratch with N_BOOT = 20 to test mechanics; only the K1 activation check and K2/K3 mechanics were inspected; gate outcomes were not inspected.
test_split: not loaded by any M1 script (assertions in scripts 20-22); test duplicate check deferred to M5
